caption: The drawing depicts a pair of nested objects: a large bowl and a smaller spoon-like bowl resting inside it. Both objects are rendered in shades of brown and gray, giving a textured, clay-like appearance. The larger bowl is circular with two slightly raised handles on opposite sides. The smaller bowl inside has a rounded basin and an elongated handle that rests on the rim of the larger bowl. The composition is centered on a plain, light cream background with no additional objects or details present. The lighting and shading suggest a three-dimensional form, with dark tones reinforcing the curvature and thickness of the bowls.
title: Maple Butter Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
